latest.title: Open a new store: the investment, and the days to earn it back
latest.summary: Expansion has a new view, Open a store. Pick a type from the neighbourhoods with the most demand, from any type, or from a Demand cell's new Open a store here, then pick the building in Find a location, fixed to that type. The board lists everything a fully outfitted store of that type needs in that building: what the type requires to open, an item for each customer demand, enough tills for the building's capacity and shelving copied from your own store of the same layout, with the installation firm's price or, for self-installation, a shopping list by furniture store on the map, and the deposit. It then estimates the profit a day from the game's own rules for customers, prices, demand and wages, with the best marketing mix, and shows how many days it takes to earn the investment back, as a range, after tax, against what your own stores of that type earn, and with an optional bank loan. Offices are estimated too; cinemas and theatres show the investment only. Your plans are kept per character. Businesses › Results also has a Payback column: for each shop, office and chain, the day its setup was earned back or how many days are still to go, with the same line on a business's own page.
